name: ffmpeg
local_changes: The official revision is retained as the offline build closure for libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil, libswresample and libswscale; programs, documentation bodies, reference media, disabled library trees and unrelated test sources are excluded.
The optional GPL-only libavcodec x86 files and the disabled x264, x265, OpenH264 and OpenCORE codec wrapper sources are excluded from the retained closure.
The outer CMake owner drives the unmodified retained sources as static PIC libraries with the checked FFmpegProfile.cmake allowlist; no patch is applied during the build.
